title: Divider
description: A thin line that separates content, horizontally or vertically, optionally with text.

props.name: length
props.description: Length of the line (width when horizontal, height when vertical)

props.name: spacing
props.description: Margin around the divider in pixels (top/bottom when horizontal, left/right when vertical)

props.name: flexItem
props.description: Vertical divider inside a flex container: stretches to the container height (align-self: stretch) instead of the 1em inline height

DividerProps.description: The line color comes from the `--divider-color` CSS custom property (default `var(--border-color)`); set it through `className` or `style`.

props.name: length
props.description: Length of the line (width when horizontal, height when vertical)

props.name: spacing
props.description: Margin around the divider in pixels (top/bottom when horizontal, left/right when vertical)

props.name: children
props.description: Optional text rendered inside a horizontal divider (ignored when vertical). Without text the divider is a native <hr>

props.name: flexItem
props.description: Vertical divider inside a flex container: stretches to the container height (align-self: stretch) instead of the 1em inline height

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root element (<hr>, or <div> when rendering text)

vars.name: --divider-spacing
vars.description: Inline margin around a vertical divider

vars.name: --divider-text-gap
vars.description: Space between the text and the lines

examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: A horizontal divider separates the first and second sections.

examples.title: Custom style
examples.description: Set the line color with the --divider-color CSS custom property (inline style, class or ancestor), and customize thickness, length, spacing and the elevation shadow.

examples.title: In a flex container
examples.description: flexItem makes a vertical divider stretch to the height of its flex container.

examples.title: Vertical
examples.description: Vertical dividers separate Home, Products and About.

examples.title: With text
examples.description: Compare Left, Center and Right labels; the right-aligned divider is dashed.
